hero.oneLiner: Vasai (Palghar)-based designer and manufacturer of pipe fitting, industrial and automotive moulds and Hot Runner Systems, which diversified into WONDRA-branded cleaning products in Fiscal 2025.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Vasai (Palghar)-based designer and manufacturer of pipe fitting, industrial and automotive moulds and Hot Runner Systems, which diversified into WONDRA-branded cleaning products in Fiscal 2025.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Om Galaxy Limited designs, develops and manufactures pipe fitting and industrial moulds for the building materials (pipes, fittings, sanitaryware) and plastic and polymer processing industries for the past 17 years; automotive moulds through subsidiary OMG Auto Mould Private Limited for the past 6 years; and Hot Runner Systems through subsidiary Infuse HRS Private Limited for the past 4 years. The moulds are used in injection moulding and blow moulding processes. During Fiscal 2025 the Company additionally diversified into moulds and finished cleaning products (mops, brushes, scrubbers, wipers, brooms) under the WONDRA brand for household, commercial and non-commercial establishments.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- OMG Auto Mould Private Limited (OMG Auto) — Direct subsidiary — Company holds 75.00%: Incorporated June 20, 2019; specialised automotive moulding solutions; Nandakumar Puthiya Veettil (promoter and director of OMG Auto) holds 25.00%
- Infuse HRS Private Limited (Infuse HRS) — Direct subsidiary — Company holds 73.00%: Incorporated October 12, 2021; manufactures Hot Runner Systems; Jawaharlal Maurya holds 23.00% and Nandakumar Puthiya Veettil (promoter and director) holds 4%
- OM Enterprises — Predecessor sole proprietorship of Promoter Opindersingh Bachattarsingh Baddhan: Established 1999 in a 1,085 sq. ft. toolroom at Gala No. 92, Virwani Industrial Estate, Western Express Highway, Goregaon (East), Mumbai
- Beacon Dies and Tools — Sole proprietorship concern of Bachattar Singh Baddhan (father of Promoter Opindersingh Bachattarsingh Baddhan): Where Promoters Opindersingh Bachattarsingh Baddhan and Sathyapal Ayadathil Poyil gained early experience
- Tool and Gauge Manufacturers Association of India (TAGMA) — Industry association — the Company is a member: Stated in Our Business overview
- Ken Research Private Limited — Industry-report provider: Report 'India Dies and Moulds Market Outlook to 2030F' dated March 23, 2026, commissioned and paid for by the Company exclusively for the Issue
- Shetty Naik & Associates — Statutory Auditor: Certified the product-vertical revenue bifurcation vide certificate dated March 29, 2026

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Forward integration into finished consumer products: 'the company is carrying out forward-integration to manufacture household and institutional cleaning items (e.g., spray bottles, brushes, scrubbers, dispensers, waste-bin containers) under the in-house brand "WONDRA," with planned additions of injection, blow, and tufting machinery and a new production facility.' During Fiscal 2025 the Company identified an opportunity in the cleaning products segment and, leveraging its legacy in mould manufacturing, diversified into manufacturing both the moulds and the finished products (mops, brushes, scrubbers, wipers, brooms) - a move from B2B into B2C. Vertical integration within tooling: through subsidiary Infuse HRS Private Limited (incorporated October 12, 2021) the group designs and manufactures hot runner systems - manifolds, nozzles and temperature controller systems - in-house, enabling composite mould-plus-HRS tooling solutions rather than standalone moulds; the DRHP states this 'differentiates us from mould manufacturers who depend on third-party hot runner suppliers'. Through subsidiary OMG Auto Mould Private Limited (incorporated June 20, 2019, Pune) the group extends into automotive moulds. In-house capabilities stated: design (specialised design software for mould engineering), machining, assembly and trial; production setup includes modular insert designs, integrated hot runner systems and large-capacity machinery. Ken Research positions the Company as 'a Forward-integrated MSME Dies and Moulds Manufacturer with HRS manufacturing Capabilities in the Indian market.' Upstream, the Company does NOT make its own steel - primary raw material is high-graded steel bought from domestic suppliers who import from global manufacturers, on a purchase-order basis with no long-term or exclusive arrangements.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Product-mix shift toward automotive moulds: automotive rose from 12.85% of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2023 to 22.92% in Fiscal 2025, while pipe fitting declined from 81.59% to 70.55% over the same period (stated in the product-vertical table)
- New Cleaning Products (WONDRA) vertical contributed nil in Fiscals 2023-2025 and 3.82% of revenue from operations (Rs 173.10 lakhs) in the six months ended September 30, 2025
- Customer concentration: top 10 customers contributed 77%, 84%, 84% and 80% of revenue from operations in H1 FY2026, Fiscal 2025, Fiscal 2024 and Fiscal 2023 respectively, without long-term binding agreements with all customers
- Domestic/export mix: 89.51% domestic and 10.49% exports of Fiscal 2025 revenue from operations, exports directed to North America, Asia and Africa
- Operating leverage from consolidating four rented/owned units into one owned New Manufacturing Unit, stated to improve operational efficiency and reduce production costs

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Set up a New Manufacturing Unit at Poman, Vasai, District Palghar to consolidate the operations of four existing Company manufacturing units at a single location
- Relocate operations from rented premises (Manufacturing Units I, III and IV) and owned premises (Manufacturing Unit-II) to fully owned premises to improve operational efficiency, reduce production costs and strengthen manufacturing capacity
- Expand production capacities through the New Manufacturing Unit (Object 1 of the Issue)
- Pre-pay / repay, in full or in part, all or a portion of certain outstanding borrowings availed by the Company (Object 2 of the Issue)
- Continue the diversification into Cleaning Products under the WONDRA brand, leveraging the legacy in mould manufacturing, selling through distributor networks and online marketplaces
- Realise listing benefits: enhance visibility and brand image among existing and potential customers and create a public market for the Equity Shares in India

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The Company is expanding infrastructure by setting up a new integrated manufacturing unit at Survey no 14, Hissa No. 3, Poman, Vasai, District Palghar (PIN printed as 4012028), Maharashtra (the 'New Manufacturing Unit'). Land admeasuring 1,23,786 sq. ft. has been purchased and a building admeasuring 1,83,965.67 sq. ft. is under construction. The unit is proposed to consolidate operations of four existing manufacturing units of the Company at a single location to streamline manufacturing processes, optimise manpower and resource utilisation, and enhance control over quality and production timelines. Operations presently carried out from rented premises at Manufacturing Units-I, III and IV and owned premises at Manufacturing Unit-II are to be relocated to fully owned premises, which is expected to improve operational efficiency, reduce production costs and strengthen manufacturing capacity. The description of what the New Manufacturing Unit will be equipped with is cut off mid-sentence in the provided text ('The New Manufacturing Unit will be equipp').

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- 17 years of operating history in pipe fitting and industrial moulds; 6 years in automotive moulds (via OMG Auto) and 4 years in Hot Runner Systems (via Infuse HRS)
- Integrated design, development and manufacturing — specialised design software for mould engineering and moulds tailored to client specifications
- Seven manufacturing units aggregating 88,652.16 sq. ft. across Vasai (Waliv, Gokhivare, Poman), District Palghar and Pune, Maharashtra, employing around 630 people
- Capability across injection moulding and blow moulding tooling, moulds upto 1720 x 1050 x 1035 mm with upto 32 cavities and automotive moulds upto 2500 x 1500 x 1000 mm
- ISO 9001:2015 certification (TUV NORD CERT GmbH) for Manufacturing Unit-I and Unit-III, and in-house testing laboratories at the Manufacturing Units
- Diversified end-market exposure: building materials, plastics and polymer processing, automotive and auto components, and industrial and engineering applications
- Export presence in North America, Asia and Africa (10.49% of Fiscal 2025 revenue from operations)
- Consolidated order book of Rs 9,489.61 Lakhs as of February 28, 2026
- Membership of the Tool and Gauge Manufacturers Association of India (TAGMA)

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Customer concentration on top 10 customers, without long-term binding agreements with all customers — Risk Factor 1 as printed: 77%, 84%, 84% and 80% of revenue from operations was derived from the top 10 customers in the six months ended September 30, 2025 and Fiscals 2025, 2024 and 2023 respectively; any reduction in orders from, or loss of, any major customer could adversely affect the business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
- Product-vertical concentration in pipe fitting moulds — Pipe fitting accounted for 70.55% of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2025 and 72.91% in the six months ended September 30, 2025 (stated in the product-vertical table), tying the business to the building materials / pipes and fittings cycle.
- Execution risk on the New Manufacturing Unit and the related consolidation of four existing units — Land of 1,23,786 sq. ft. purchased and a 1,83,965.67 sq. ft. building under construction, with operations at Units I, II, III and IV to be relocated; the capex is an Object of the Issue and its funding amounts are marked [as being fixed later] in the provided text.
- Reliance on the commissioned Ken Research Report for industry information — The DRHP itself flags this: the report was commissioned by and paid for by the Company exclusively for the Issue, and any reliance on such information for making an investment decision is subject to inherent risks (Risk Factor at page 61).
- Operations concentrated in a single geographic cluster — All seven manufacturing units are in Maharashtra — six in Vasai/Gokhivare/Poman, District Palghar, and one at Kuruli, Taluka Khed, District Pune.
- Partial ownership of the subsidiaries that carry the automotive and HRS businesses — The Company holds 75.00% of OMG Auto and 73.00% of Infuse HRS; minority holders (Nandakumar Puthiya Veettil 25.00% / 4%, Jawaharlal Maurya 23.00%) hold the balance.
- Tenancy risk on rented manufacturing premises — Manufacturing Units I, III and IV are stated to be rented premises, with Unit-II owned; relocation to fully owned premises is proposed but not yet completed.
- Newly launched Cleaning Products vertical with no track record before Fiscal 2025 — The WONDRA vertical recorded nil revenue in Fiscals 2023-2025 and its first stated contribution, Rs 173.10 lakhs (3.82%), came in the six months ended September 30, 2025; 57 SKUs as of February 28, 2026.

commitments.body:

- **Consolidate the operations of four existing Company manufacturing units into the New Manufacturing Unit, relocating rented Units-I, III and IV and owned Unit-II to fully owned premises.**
- **Relocation to fully owned premises is expected to improve operational efficiency, reduce production costs and strengthen manufacturing capacity.**
- **Pre-payment / re-payment, in full or in part, of all or a portion of certain outstanding borrowings availed by the Company, from the Net Proceeds.**
- **Consolidated order book of Rs 9,489.61 Lakhs as of February 28, 2026, to be converted into revenue.**
- **Scale the Cleaning Products vertical under the WONDRA brand (moulds plus finished products such as mops, brushes, scrubbers, wipers and brooms) sold to households and commercial/non-commercial establishments through distributor networks …**
- **Expansion of production capacities alongside the consolidation, stated as part of Object 1 of the Issue.**
- **Enhance visibility and brand image among existing and potential customers and create a public market for the Equity Shares in India through the listing.**
- **The Company, in consultation with the BRLM, may undertake a Pre-IPO Placement prior to filing of the Red Herring Prospectus with the RoC; if undertaken it shall not exceed 20% of the Fresh Issue size and the amount raised will be reduced …**
- **Deploy a portion of the Net Proceeds towards General Corporate Purposes (Object 3).**
